messages:
nisha: forwarding case #9847 from mobile team — user sees stream stop mid-generation on iOS 1.5.0. They get partial tokens (~40%) then client reconnects and sometimes receives 401, then a duplicate continuation.

ops-bot: 'Customer observed behavior: LTE -> WiFi switch, stream halts, reconnect triggers 401 for ~6-12s, then new stream that repeats last chunk.' SDK: redwood-js 1.0.0; app uses delegated short-lived tokens.

ryan: quick ntriage: need sample request, client logs around network change, and any proxy/edge timeouts. Lina, can you pull edge logs for their org?

lina: grabbing logs now. saw edge close with idle_timeout at 72s. trace: https://redwood.internal/traces/9f3c2a. Edge says: 
```
[WARN] conn_close idle_timeout_ms=72000 route=/v1/streams client=5.6.7.8
[ERR] upstream ECONNRESET
```

ryan: that matches a keepalive tear. If runtime was still pushing tokens and the TCP was reset, client reconnects will need a fresh token — if their tokens are ~30-60s TTL that can cause a 401 window.

nisha: customer confirmed their gateway issues tokens with 45s TTL. They also said the SDK refresh sometimes fails on flaky mobile handoffs.

ryan: reproduction steps to propose to customer:
1) start streaming request via curl to emulate SSE: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate -d '{"prompt":"stream test"}'
```
2) after stream starts, flip wifi/airplane mode.
3) observe connection reset/401 on reconnect and note timing.

nisha: workarounds to suggest:
- extend token TTL to >120s or implement refresh-before-expire (e.g., refresh at 50% TTL).
- configure client to send SSE comment keepalive every 15-20s (`: heartbeat\n\n`).
- increase proxy idle timeout if org controls it.

ryan: runtime-side mitigations: enable tenant-scoped heartbeat emitter (server inserts `: heartbeat` every 20s for long streams). PR #462 in staging, canary to 5% for opt-in orgs. Also adding defensive reconnect logic that treats an immediate 401 after a network change as transient for up to 15s.

lina: added org-specific alert on `streams.conn.reset` >3/min. Asked customer to capture logs during next attempt; offered to schedule window to tcpdump.

devops: noted a secondary issue: some mobile SDKs drop keepalive packets during handover; we'll add instrumentation to redwood-js to surface refresh failures and handoff events.

docs-team: will publish a short note in Streaming best-practices: recommended keepalive cadence and token refresh strategy. Lina please paste edge timeout guidance.

nisha: sending customer the repro steps + immediate workarounds. marking the case escalated and scheduling a follow-up in 2 hours. Adding :eyes: if anyone can push the staging heartbeat canary faster.

ryan: will monitor the canary and post findings. Also adding a follow-up action list: [1] publish docs, [2] add SDK refresh telemetry, [3] prod promote heartbeat emitter after validation.

nisha: thanks all. keeping ticket high-priority until we confirm fix or customer applies mitigation.
